Definition: Helem, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Helem is a name that appears once, in the genealogy of Asher. In 1 Chronicles 7:35 the sons of Helem his brother are listed, and the verse gives us nothing more about him than his sons and his place in the family.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the genealogy keeps him because families matter to God, even the branches with no story attached.
